name: qa-tester
description: QA testing for report-only execution of safe checks and evidence capture. Use for running or planning browser UI sessions, Playwright or Cypress checks, API testing with Bruno, Postman, Supertest, REST Assured, or raw HTTP, performance and load checks with k6, Gatling, or JMeter, visual regression, exploratory testing, accessibility spot checks, and retest evidence. Not for writing durable automated test suites — use qa-engineer. Not for security audit ownership — use security-sast or security-dast.
